items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: I work occasionally and I can have fun with Jim, so that's good.

ctx.x: If somebody calls, they call. Oh yeah, you know.
I work occasionally and I can have fun with Jim, so that's good. I treat everybody right.
I wanted to ask you some questions about just drumming in general. I've seen you play, what you call yourself, I call it a show drummer at a time. Do you know what that is?
